title: Own Word, Excel, and Outlook on your Mac for $99.97 with no yearly bill
content:
Macworld

TL;DR: Cancel Microsoft 365 and get Office Home & Business 2021 for Mac with a lifetime license for $99.97 (reg. $219).

A Microsoft 365 plan keeps Word and Excel on your Mac only as long as the annual payment is processed. To own the apps outright instead, pick up a lifetime license to Microsoft Office Home & Business 2021 for Mac. One $99.97 payment (reg. $219) puts the suite on your Mac for good.

You get Word, Excel, PowerPoint, Outlook, and OneNote, plus the basic version of Microsoft Teams. Each app installs locally and runs on macOS Sonoma, Sequoia, and Tahoe. Activation goes through your Microsoft Account rather than a specific device, using a one-time code for one Mac.

Because this is Office 2021 and not Microsoft 365, there’s no OneDrive storage or Copilot. Microsoft ended support for Office 2021 on October 13, 2026, and your copy comes with the final update Microsoft released. Codes need to be redeemed within seven days of purchase.

Pay for Office once, and keep it on your Mac.
